mapper.insert:
insert into approval_task ( document_id, step_order, user_id, document_type, status, comment, step_name ) values
( #{task.documentId}, #{task.stepOrder}, #{task.userId}, #{task.documentType}, #{task.status}, #{task.comment}, #{task.stepName} )
mapper.select: select apt.step_order, apt.step_name, CONCAT_WS(' ', u.last_name, u.first_name) as user_name, apt.status, apt.comment, cast(apt.acted_at as date) as acted_at from approval_task apt join users u on apt.user_id = u.user_id where apt.document_id = #{documentId}
